Title: Survey the city
Description: Pan, zoom, and rotate the camera. The city is yours to command.

Title: Build a farm
Description: Open the build menu and place an Urban Farm so the city can eat.

Title: Raise a militia
Description: Recruit a militia squad from the military panel.

Title: Survive the night
Description: Hold the city for one full day.

Title: Enact quarantine
Description: Slow the spread: toggle the Quarantine emergency policy.

Title: Raise the walls
Description: Drag a wall line of at least 8 segments around a district.

Title: Raise a militia
Description: Recruit a militia squad to hunt Patient Zero's wake.

Title: Start triage research
Description: Begin researching Triage Protocols at a medical center.

Title: Hold Kingsport
Description: Survive 30 in-game days (30 real minutes at 1x) without falling.

Title: Hold Port Hope
Description: Survive 20 days against the virulent strain.

Title: Restore power
Description: Keep at least one powered generator or plant online.
